scope: BlockEdit Add Object, Remove Object, Set Base Point and chronological member serialization
native_engine: Rhino 8.32.26160.13001 x86-64 through ARM64 Wine/FEX on private Xvfb
launcher_note: The current launcher failed licensing because AcquireCredentialsHandleW was missing from its selected security library. Per-process built-in security overrides restored normal licensed startup without modifying the launcher or Wine configuration.
native_input: Worker deferred to the public Rhino idle event. Owned dialog buttons were located through public Win32/WPF interfaces and physically clicked. A DispatcherTimer inspected the public CommandPrompt property for getter readiness/completion. Prescribed object IDs or world coordinates were delivered to the owned command field; point submissions could be retried while the same getter remained active. The final capture ran automatically. The broader capture precedes the final active-prompt retry guard; a focused post-guard native recapture is recorded separately.
copy_contract: External sources remain in the model. Copies join the edited prototype; copied nested references clear geometry text while original sources retain their raw text. Prototype groups are cleared on save.
release_contract: Removed members stay protected during editing and become independent world-space model objects on save. Discard restores the original document and redo branch. Release and base-point changes have isolated workspace history and fold into the one saved model edit.
base_point_contract: The selected world point is mapped to the instance-local frame and subtracted from saved member coordinates. Original root placements stay fixed; released geometry retains its world coordinates.
ordering_contract: Saved prototype members follow reverse temporary-object chronology. Geometry replacement renews temporary order; ordering history restores it. The oracle distinguishes per-object SDK transforms from batched native Move and compares ordered member arrays with attached metadata.
performance_scope: Save uses one member scan and the source chooser avoids repeated model-table searches and formats visible rows. No native timing or GPU speedup was measured.
comparison_limits: Sixteen owned recipes and 82 closed-model states at absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12. Points, grouped sources, nested references and one uniformly reflected circle; finite sampled curve witnesses do not certify all curved geometry. Native temporary-object metadata, selection/history, broader panel behavior and stress/numeric boundary parity remain open.
remaining_scope: Viewport picking of external sources and base points
Hidden/locked-member warning choices and empty placements
Persistence of open editors and linked definitions
Broader geometry, numeric and native selection/history qualification
